principles: Keep every claim consistent with the admission letter, transcripts, CV, and financial documents.
Do not exaggerate motivation or future plans.
Do not write facts that cannot be supported.
Tailor the content to the exact institution, program, and visa purpose.

banned_phrases: I want to settle in Korea permanently
Any university in Korea is fine
This is only for visa approval
I have no specific academic reason
My sponsor will definitely cover everything without proof
at the end of the day

preferred_replacements.I want PR: I plan to use this qualification to advance my career after graduation.
preferred_replacements.any university in Korea is fine: This program best matches my academic interests.
